BOT RECOMMENDATION: if approved, approve TEAL-FIRST and drop or defer the dove half. 8 days to kill_date. + 31/07 TEAL HALF STRENGTHENS AGAIN, score held 3/5. (c) Radar context corrected: 0/11 rotation brands run opener-countdown creative, but Tom Beckbe now leads its homepage with 'Tom Beckbe x Ducks Unlimited' ($495 DU Fowler Vest, $375 DU Double Timber Bag) — the conservation-partnership language a species-art brand might otherwise reach for is being taken at the premium tier. pending.title: Numbered Species Drop — capsule species-art phat hanh danh so, so luong chot, zero discount (mechanics hoc tu Free Fly x Trout Unlimited)
pending.kill_criteria: (1) OPENER-CAPSULE-2026 bi reject -> mat vehicle gan nhat, xet lai; (2) xuat hien case limited-drop e/khong ban het o tier accessible (<$60) cho thay mechanics khong dich xuong duoi premium
pending.evidence: 27/07: FF x TU hoodie 'ONLY 500 AVAILABLE' featured homepage (species art + conservation + numbered scarcity, $98). 28/07: product page live = SOLD OUT ('Out of Stock $98', 'Only 0 left'); page states year-1 drop sold out in 24h; 2nd annual 2026 edition -> annual-franchise mechanics (restock-as-news + scarcity). Chua co case nao o tier <$60 — do la cau hoi mo. + 29/07: Duck Camp Game Series is an ALWAYS-ON program (not numbered, not capped) and 14/32 SKUs already discounted to $25 — so it is not a counter-example to limited/numbered mechanics at the sub-$60 tier. Score held 3/5. + 30/07: no new evidence for or against. Adjacent finding worth noting for whoever decides — GritFell already has 36 species-embroidery hats at one price with NO program name and NO season tag, while Duck Camp bundles 32 into 'Game Series / New for Fall 26'. A named program is the cheapest version of this mechanic and needs no price or scarcity change. Score held 3/5, 22 days to kill_date. + 31/07: mild support, score held 3/5. Complete 90-SKU sweep shows 0/90 GritFell SKUs have ever carried sale pricing — the no-discount discipline a numbered/limited drop depends on is already the brand's actual operating posture, so the mechanic would not require a behaviour change. Independently, both T6 rotation brands (Howler $75-145, Tom Beckbe $195-495) also run zero discounts, i.e. no-discount is the norm above the mid tier rather than an eccentric stance. Still NO observed case of numbered/limited mechanics at the sub-$60 tier — that remains the open question. 21 days to kill_date.
